businessModel: Free; funded by search partnerships and ads (unverified)
summary: A Chromium-based privacy browser that blocks third-party cookies and ads (uBlock Origin fork) and offers a browser-only proxy; updates are manual and trail Chromium by several versions.
bestFor: People wanting a preconfigured privacy Chromium on Windows/macOS
Those who like built-in proxy and ad-block
notFor: Anyone who needs timely security patches
Users who need mobile support (Android stale)

pros.title: Privacy defaults
pros.detail: Third-party cookies blocked; built-in ad blocker.

pros.title: Browser proxy
pros.detail: Built-in proxy routes browser traffic (not the full system).

pros.title: Free and simple
pros.detail: No account needed; privacy settings preconfigured.

cons.title: No auto-update
cons.detail: Reported as a drawback by FileHorse.

faq.a: Windows 152.0.7977.6 (about four majors behind Chromium 156); Android 138.
A browser-only proxy that does not cover system traffic.

timeline.event: Epic Privacy Browser first released (Firefox-based originally)
